head: Galaxy Fit 4 price leak: €79.90 in France, says Dealabs
dek: Samsung's next fitness band may cost €79.90 in France, €10 more than the Galaxy Fit 3's €69.90, according to French site Dealabs. Samsung hasn't announced the Fit 4 or a launch date.
details: Dealabs says it comes to Europe in black, silver and green. FCC papers from August list a speaker, a first for the Fit line, Bluetooth 5.4 and a button on the right, with no Wi-Fi, LTE, NFC or GPS. Sammy Guru found heart-rate, blood oxygen, stress and sleep tracking, automatic workout detection and Samsung Wallet support in the Fit 4's app. The price is for France only.
where: Not announced: leaked price for France; no date
means: If you were waiting for the Fit 4, expect it to cost a little more than the Fit 3 in France, if the leak is right. Other countries' prices aren't known.
todo: Nothing to do yet; Samsung hasn't set a date.
